title: ollama/ollama: Release v0.40.11

topic.reason: Neue KI-Modelle, Funktionen, Benchmarks (Treffer: model, llm, llama)

summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.40.11): ## Speech Ollama can now generate [speech](https://docs.ollama.com/capabilities/speech) on macOS. `ollama run` plays text or a chat model's reply aloud as the audio is generated, and apps can stream audio through the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint. ```sh ollama run phonon "Hello from Ollama." ``` ## d3 decision models [d3](https://ollama.com/library/d3) brings vLLM Semantic Router's decision models to Ollama. Give a model text, structured state, or an image, and ask it to classify, answer yes or no, or score options with probabilities. The family includes 2B, 4B, 9B, and 27B sizes. ```sh ollama run d3 "A customer says their card was charged twice." --ask "Is this a billing issue?" ``` ## New Contributors * @SynapShift made their first contribution in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19173 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.10...v0.40.11
